title: Site map canvas: where district curation is stored
context: Phase 3 lets people make the map theirs: drag districts to rearrange, rename, recolor, with positions persisted and never auto-reflowed (IKEA effect + spatial memory). The persistence home decides whether that spatial memory is shared: team-shared rides docs/site-map/ next to answers.yaml (in PR diffs, one map everyone recognizes), personal lives in a git-ignored .paqad local file (no PR churn, but every teammate arranges their own city), hybrid is team base plus local override (most flexible, most code and merge semantics).
rationale: Owner locked via tray 2026-08-18: the map is shared documentation, so spatial memory is shared too; layout file lives in docs/site-map/ next to answers.yaml and rides PR diffs. Hybrid local-override can evolve later if demanded.
